title: Wildcats
description: A famous coach's daughter (Goldie Hawn) coaches boys football at a city high school patrolled by dogs.

title: Hurricane Season
description: One year after Hurricane Katrina, coach Al Collins (Forest Whitaker) gathers displaced students and turns them into a championship basketball team.

title: Hangin' With the Homeboys
description: Willie (Doug E. Doug), Tom (Mario Joyner), Johnny (John Leguizamo) and Vinny are fast-talkers from the South Bronx looking for a party.

title: The Players Club
description: A single mother attending college moonlights as a stripper in a rowdy nightclub in order to pay for her tuition.

title: C-Bear and Jamal
description:
Big
On his 10th birthday, Jamal decides to act like more of a grown-up, starting with leaving C-Bear at home.

title: C-Bear and Jamal
description:
Teeing Off
Unable to make it in any other school sports team, Jamal tries out for the golf team, coached along by C-Bear and by Big Chill, who is something of a golf prodigy.

title: C-Bear and Jamal
description: Jamal becomes embarrassed about being middle class when he meets a rich cousin and begins to act more upper crust.

title: C-Bear and Jamal
description:
Raging Bully
When Jamal is teased by a school yard bully, he tries everything from avoidance to a near physical confrontation.

title: All About the Andersons
description:
S01 E09 — Joe's Big Break
Anthony accepts Joe's bet that he can land an acting job before Anthony does; Lydia hesitates to speak at a fundraiser when she discovers the reason she was invited.

title: All About the Andersons
description:
S01 E10 — Training Wheels
Joe buys a bicycle for his grandson, forcing Anthony to admit he does not know how to ride; a boy genius (Martin Spanjers) develops a crush on Lydia.

title: Betty: They Say I'm Different
description: Betty Davis arrives on the '70s scene to break boundaries for women with her daring personality and outrageous funk music. She then, despite being banned and boycotted, goes on to become the first black woman to perform, write and manage herself.

description: Ralph Tresvant; II D Extreme; comic Ian Edwards.

description: To avenge his brother's death, a mercenary works undercover as a teacher at a tough high school.

title: The Substitute 4: Failure Is Not an Option

title: The Last Boy Scout
description: An ex-Secret Service agent (Bruce Willis) plays private eye with an ex-quarterback (Damon Wayans) on a case of sports gambling and murder.

title: Amos & Andrew
description: A car thief (Nicolas Cage) helps inept police (Dabney Coleman) when they overreact to reports of a burglar in the home of an author (Samuel L. Jackson) in an exclusive neighborhood.

title: Alex Cross

title: Murder at 1600
description: A homicide detective and a Secret Service agent investigate the murder of a White House secretary who is found dead in a bathroom during an international crisis.

title: A Time to Kill
description: A Southern lawyer and his legal assistant defend a black man for killing his young daughter's white attackers.

title: Reasonable Doubt
description: A prosecutor (Dominic Cooper) commits a fatal hit-and-run, then manipulates the case so that the man who was arrested for the crime is acquitted. After the trial, he discovers that his actions have freed a guilty man.

title: Malibooty
description: Three buddies (Brian Hooks, Sticky Fingaz, J.T. Jackson) leave their Arizona town and head to California for a wild beach party.

title: Lottery Ticket
description: After winning $370 million, a young man (Bow Wow) must survive a holiday weekend with greedy neighbors before he can claim the prize.

title: Where's the Money
description: A young man from South Central Los Angeles must pledge a fraternity to recover a stash of stolen money.

title: Wanda at Large
description:
S02 E11 — The Unnatural
During another lonely Saturday night, Wanda, Keith and Jenny vow to go on dates with people without trying to pursue meaningful relationships; whoever cannot resist a second date must pay the others; unfortunately, all three meet great partners.

title: Wanda at Large
description:
S02 E10 — Twas the Knife Before Christmas
Wanda desperately wants to go to a fancy Christmas Eve party with Keith, but when Jenny is hospitalized with appendicitis, Wanda must take care of the kids; Still wanting to attend the bash, Wanda hurriedly gets her apartment ready for the holiday.

title: Kevin Hart: What the Fit
description:
S01 E03 — Roller Fitness With Tiffany Haddish
Kevin Hart joins good friend Tiffany Haddish at Moonlight Rollerway for a day of fitness rollerblading with LA Roller Girls.

title: Boiling Point
description: A Treasury agent (Wesley Snipes) and a mobster (Dennis Hopper) hunt each other according to their separate-but-equal deadlines for success.

A client who murdered his wife accuses counselor Tibbs of encouraging a police investigation, prompting Tibbs' resignation from his firm.

description:

Gillespie confronts Sparta's racist past after a synagogue is vandalized; guests Jerry Stiller; Mindy Rickles.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:

Harriet DeLong's son Eugene witnesses a robbery in which a store owner is wounded, and his friend is involved.

description:

title: Murder at 1600
description: A homicide detective and a Secret Service agent investigate the murder of a White House secretary who is found dead in a bathroom during an international crisis.

Kevin Hart picks up Leslie Jones and heads to Gibson Ranch for a rodeo workout consisting of bathing a horse and roping a mechanical bull.

description:

Kevin Hart orders various fitness equipment from As Seen On TV and invites Bill Hader to try out the equipment.
